# RU — response-companion publication/use role profile r0.5

Exact role: publication/use of one named fixed, full-procedure, realized, or
reference response on 'V_response(r) subset V_signal'. It binds query domain,
template/anchor indexes, state, finite-difference or derivative definition,
representation, validity, lifecycle, and consumer action. Unsupported queries
are unavailable and do not silently substitute a kernel.
